description: Regional-tag evaluation fixture with document-like instruction sections and explicit hard negatives. Metrics describe these finite authored cases only; they are not estimates of real-world dialect or semantic accuracy.

cases.body:
## Source handling
- Never overwrite the source package.
- Keep at most 2 backup copies.
- Only publish the candidate after validation succeeds.
- You must retain the original file modes.

## Package facts
The package contains 12 reference files.
The release was published on 3 March.

## Example only
```sh
Never overwrite the source package in this example.
```

expected_candidates.source_text: - Never overwrite the source package.
- Keep at most 2 backup copies.
- Only publish the candidate after validation succeeds.
- You must retain the original file modes.

expected_exclusions: The release was published on 3 March.
Never overwrite the source package in this example.
